query: GitHub REST API issues create issue endpoint documentation
facts: body params: title (required), body, assignees, labels, milestone, type
Any user with pull access can create an issue; issues disabled -> 410 Gone
This endpoint triggers notifications; creating content too quickly may hit secondary rate limits
Issues endpoints may return pull requests; identify them by the pull_request key
No endpoint for uploading/attaching binary files to an issue is listed on this page
note: 本 record の中心的事実は『Issues の REST API に添付 (file upload) の endpoint が無い』こと。同一 API 群の一覧に該当 endpoint が存在しないことをもって確認した。
